citation: Kontou E, et al. 2022. A Week of Sleep Restriction Does Not Affect Nighttime Glucose Concentration in Healthy Adult Males When Slow-Wave Sleep Is Maintained. Sensors 22:6962.
protocol: Baseline night 9 h in bed (23:00-08:00), then 7 nights of 9 h (23:00-08:00) or 5 h (03:00-08:00) in bed; interstitial glucose by CGM every 5 min through the night
population: n=41 healthy adult males: 9 h group n=23 (age 24.0 y), 5 h group n=18 (age 21.9 y)

reports.where: Table 3, mean glucose during time in bed on baseline and experimental night 7, plus text

note: Overnight CGM means, not OGTT; paper states all data are mean +/- SD. Figures show the overnight curves.
